title: 3-Day The Essence of Bahrain - Heritage & Modern Wonders
summary: Experience the rich heritage and modern wonders of Bahrain in a compact 3-day tour. Highlights include the Al Fateh Grand Mosque, Bahrain National Museum, and the traditional Manama Souq.

dayPlans.title: Arrival in Bahrain
dayPlans.description: Upon arrival at Bahrain International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred to your hotel in Manama. The rest of the day is at leisure.
dayPlans.accommodation: Bahrain International Hotel / Delmon International Hotel

dayPlans.title: Heritage Tour of Manama
dayPlans.description: After breakfast, embark on a city tour exploring Bahrain's rich history and modern landmarks.
dayPlans.accommodation: Bahrain International Hotel / Delmon International Hotel

dayPlans.title: Departure
dayPlans.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before checking out and transferring to Bahrain International Airport for your departure flight.

title: 4-Day Ultimate Bahrain Discovery
summary: Discover the ultimate Bahrain experience over 4 days, combining heritage city tours with desert discovery. Visit ancient burial mounds, the first oil well, and the world-famous Bahrain International Circuit.
highlights: Al Fateh Grand Mosque & Bahrain Museum
Tree of Life & First Oil Well

dayPlans.description: City tour covering the Al Fateh Grand Mosque, Bahrain National Museum, Beit Al Quran, and traditional Manama Souq.

dayPlans.title: Departure
dayPlans.description: Check out and transfer to Bahrain International Airport for your departure flight.

title: 5-Day Bahrain Grand Prix Race, Stay & Guided Tour
summary: The ultimate Formula 1 experience at the 2027 Bahrain Grand Prix. Includes a 3-day Victory Grandstand ticket, private transfers, and a choice of guided heritage and cultural tours.
highlights: 3-Day Bahrain Grand Prix Victory Grandstand Ticket
Al Fateh Grand Mosque & Bahrain National Museum

dayPlans.title: Arrival & Check-in
dayPlans.description: Arrive in Bahrain, transfer to your hotel and prepare for an exciting weekend of racing.

dayPlans.title: F1 Practice & Guided Tour
dayPlans.description: Enjoy a private guided tour of Bahrain (choose from Cultural, Desert, or Islamic heritage) before heading to the circuit for practice sessions.

dayPlans.title: F1 Qualifying
dayPlans.description: Experience the thrill of F1 qualifying under the lights at the Bahrain International Circuit.

dayPlans.title: Race Day
dayPlans.description: Witness the 2027 Bahrain Grand Prix from the Victory Grandstand.

dayPlans.title: Departure
dayPlans.description: Private transfer to the airport for your departure flight.

title: Romantic Ceylon: Honeymoon & Coastal Escape
summary: A beautifully curated 5-day honeymoon escape traversing Sri Lanka's cultural foothills, cool misty tea mountains, and tropical southern coastlines.
highlights: Scenic Tea Estate Ascent & Ramboda Falls

dayPlans.title: Arrival & Hill Country Charm
dayPlans.description: Warm welcome at BIA Airport, scenic hill transfer with a stop at Pinnawala to observe elephants bathing, followed by a guided Kandy City Tour.

dayPlans.title: Botanic Gardens to Little England
dayPlans.description: Visit the renowned Peradeniya Royal Botanic Gardens, ascend into the cool mountain valleys, stop at Ramboda Water Falls, and take a Nuwara Eliya City Tour.

dayPlans.title: Mountain Descent & Beach Sunset
dayPlans.description: Scenic descent from the central highlands to the tropical southern coastline. Relax along the wide golden sand beaches of Bentota.

dayPlans.title: Mangroves & Colombo Metropolis
dayPlans.description: Stop at the Madhu River for an optional boat safari, proceed via the southern expressway to Colombo, and enjoy a comprehensive city tour and retail shopping.

dayPlans.title: Departure
dayPlans.description: Hotel breakfast, souvenir shopping, and a direct private airport drop-off for your flight home.

title: The Cool Highlands & Luxury Retreat
summary: Designed for travelers seeking privacy, cooler climates, and unhurried luxury pacing. Experience the royal hill capital of Kandy, the crisp mountain air of Nuwara Eliya, and private mangrove boat safaris in Bentota.
highlights: Temple of the Tooth Relic Ceremony

dayPlans.title: Arrival & Hills
dayPlans.description: VIP reception at Colombo International Airport, en route stop at Pinnawala, and arrival at your luxury retreat overlooking the Kandy hills.

dayPlans.title: Royal Botanical & Sacred Tooth
dayPlans.description: Stroll through Peradeniya Royal Botanic Gardens, visit gem ateliers, and attend traditional evening drum rituals at the Temple of the Tooth Relic.

dayPlans.title: Tea Trail Ascent
dayPlans.description: Drive through dramatic mountain passes, stopping at Ramboda Falls. Tour a historic working tea factory and taste pure single-estate Ceylon tea.

dayPlans.title: Alpine Leisure & Boating
dayPlans.description: Private speedboat cruising on Gregory Lake, visit hydroponic strawberry greenhouses, and enjoy high tea on the manicured lawns of The Grand Hotel.

dayPlans.title: Mangroves & Golden Beach
dayPlans.description: Descend to the golden southwest coast. Embark on a private safari boat ride along the Madu River, navigating dense mangrove tunnels.

dayPlans.title: Metropolis & Shopping
dayPlans.description: Visit the Kosgoda sea turtle conservation project, then head to Colombo for a city tour, exquisite lunch, and luxury souvenir shopping.

dayPlans.title: Departure
dayPlans.description: Enjoy seaside breakfast and artisan souvenir shopping before a direct chauffeur transfer to the airport.
